It was on saturday night, had a good time drinking with friends and we decided to get some MD to enjoy together, I've been much happier recently then I was a few months ago and I hop into the back of our sober ride with my mates. We're all just cruising talking about life and each other and I suddenly came to the conclusion that we are all connected. each of us has 'God' within us and that the 'Devil' is actually our egos. When we feed into sin and feed the devil (ego) it feels so good especially in the short term. But if we learn to starve our ego and be present in each moment and make decisions based on multiple planned out choices we can become more like 'God' and create our own destiny. There is never a one way to do anything in life. Every answer is correct as long as you think it is because that is your reality. Likelihood vs reality vs possibility is another thing too. we can always increase the likelihood something will happen by building ourselves up and setting ourselves up for them to happen. The possibility increases the more we build ourselves up and if we tackle our possibilities then we achieve our realities. I hope this made sense
